human_listening_checklist: Each word is pronounced as ONE natural word (never letter by letter), except real acronyms such as SQL or CPU.
Syllable count and stressed syllable match the table shown in Pronunciation Studio.
Indian English voice: clear, no American/British caricature, no pauses inside words.
Hindi words (ab, hum, ka, samajhte, hain) are pronounced as Hindi, not as English letters.
At language switches (Machine Learning -> ka -> concept) there is no unnatural pause or change of loudness.
No word is dropped, repeated or replaced by a different word.
Slow mode is slower but still natural, not syllable-by-syllable.
